ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity macro-level ratio; predominantly white central field (approx. 85%) bordered by high-contrast black perimeter pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white central zone spanning both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the lateral margins, distal apices, and trailing edge serrations; isolated dark pixel clusters near the median notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; steep symmetrical inward slope toward a central focal point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary; characteristic peaks and valleys with multiple secondary V-shaped notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward-curving trajectory from the central notch to the distal tips; lobes terminate in sharp, tapering apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel cluster located at the lower central junction; sparse dark speckles distributed across the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned dark linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface near the trailing edge serrations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge forming irregular serrations; distinct orange-brownish pigmentation patch on the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights (glare) on the mid-left lobe surface; water spray obscuring the lower peduncle junction.
